horseshoeCrab: Ah, this aged shell of mine creaks so. Send an old soul on his way, young lad?
There was a time when all beings roamed the seabed. Indeed, one misses those days long gone.
Those who one once traveled with are now long gone, their traces vanished from this world.
Hmph! Compared to yesteryear, the hunters of this age are scrawny beings.
Forgive this body’s torpidness; one has been bound to this wheelchair for a long while.
Young lad, don’t make the same mistakes one did. If you can save someone, do not stand by and send them to their deaths.
One still hears their voices screaming…one cannot tell if they are from dreams of old or sufferings of the present.
Technology and transportation are so advanced these days…one cannot help but feel like a foreigner in this age.
Young lad, you should get out and enjoy this life with your loved ones. Do not dedicate your life to survival, and end up being the last lonely one.
...My friends? …They were known in the history books as brave warriors, but one wishes to remember them outside of their assigned descriptions.
